field.label: Enable
field.help: Start Newt automatically and connect this firewall to your Pangolin site.

field.label: Pangolin URL
field.help: HTTPS address of your Pangolin server.

field.label: Site ID
field.help: Newt ID from the site configuration in Pangolin.

field.label: Site Secret
field.help: Site secret from Pangolin. Keep the existing value when continuing to use this site.

field.label: Log Level
field.help: Use Info for normal operation and Debug for troubleshooting.

field.label: MTU
field.help: Tunnel packet size. Keep 1280 unless your network requires another value.

field.label: Client Tunnel Port
field.help: Optional fixed UDP listening port. Leave empty to choose automatically.

field.label: DNS Server
field.help: Optional DNS server for Newt to resolve its destinations. Leave empty to use the Newt default.
